lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11-13 visible white vertical lines on the right flank; lines are more distinct in the mid-posterior region and become thinner and less continuous towards the anterior shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments in the mid-torso are fragmented or terminate prematurely before reaching the dorsal or ventral margins, particularly the fourth and sixth lines from the posterior end.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of three distinct, high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch/thigh region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two of the posterior spots align along a near-horizontal axis on the mid-thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate, spiraling trajectory, diverging outwards from the skull base before curving inwards and slightly backwards at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips constitute approximately 7-9% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse chevron between the medial canthi of the eyes; a dense white dorsal crest of hair extends along the entire spine.
